business_summary.text: Man Infraconstruction Limited is a real estate development company with a focus on premium residential and commercial projects in Mumbai, including ultra-luxury developments under the MS collection.

call_points.text: FY27 PAT growth guidance maintained at over 25% YoY
Target cumulative pre-sales of ₹5,000 Cr over next two years
No plans for debt or equity fundraising, will remain debt-free

guidance.statement: Cumulative pre-sales over next two years

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Realty > Residential, Commercial Projects

operating_notes.text: 90% of inventory sold at Aaradhya Parkwood project
30% of inventory sold at Marina Vista project in 2 months
75% of inventory sold at Atmosphere O2 project

timeline.summary: Man Infraconstruction Limited held Q1FY27 Virtual Analyst Meet on August 21, 2026, reporting 29% YoY PAT growth to ₹72 Cr and maintaining FY27 guidance.

watchlist.response: Sales are lumpy with major launches like Marine Lines (₹3,000+ Cr GDV) and Berkeley House (₹1,000+ Cr GDV) yet to come, with confidence in achieving target
watchlist.text: Q1FY27 pre-sales of ₹290 Cr is lower than expected compared to ₹5,000 Cr target over two years
